purpose: Second single-axis replication: the fill_only_conservative prompt at seeds 2 and 3, three traces, three repeats. Run to test whether the 78.16% cross-seed CV measured on grid_v6 (seeds 1,2,3) is a property of the design family or of the particular seed triple.

run.host: GCP compute instance chia-grid2, us-east1-b, c2d-standard-8, sponsor-funded project

gate_correction.why_that_was_wrong: This VM was one commit behind: it ran c89ce81, which predates the axis-level fix in 118d313. The grid holds the prompt constant, so max prompt spread was computed over a single level, returned 0.0, and satisfied nothing -- and because the old gate only tested the seed and repeat axes, an unexercised prompt axis produced a clean PASS with no blocker recorded.
gate_correction.note: The reproducibility verdict itself does NOT change: with two real seed levels the cross-seed CV is a genuine 0.0000%, not a vacuous one. What changes is the publish gate, which the old code passed while an axis went unmeasured. This is a second live instance of the same false PASS, produced by running the unfixed gate rather than by a different kind of mistake.

what_this_adds: It narrows the headline, and the narrowing matters. grid_v6/v7 drew its three seeds from .tmp/grid_cand; this grid drew seeds 2 and 3 from .tmp/cand_fact2. Those directories contain DIFFERENT programs under the SAME module names: gen_fill_only_conservative_s2 is file sha256 d3b488833a362800 (1210 source chars) in grid_cand and fba763d78e5bc047 (1107 chars) in cand_fact2. On BFSCC the grid_cand s2 measures 6,420,195 cycles while the cand_fact2 s2 measures 95,624,440 -- a 15x gap that is fully explained by different inputs, not by a measurement disagreement. Within cand_fact2, seeds 2 and 3 reproduce each other bit-exactly on all three traces (cross-seed CV 0.0000%). So the 78.16% cross-seed CV is a property of ONE generated series, not of LLM-driven generation in general, and a seed label is not a design identifier across series. The paper's reproducibility claim is scoped accordingly.

cross_series_name_collision.consequence: Any comparison of 'the same design' across candidate directories must be keyed on candidate_sha256 or design_sha256. The two grids' raw.json files already record both, and they differ, which is what made this detectable.

known_gaps: raw.json records HEAD at write time, not at stage entry, so the SHA above was recovered from the host-side clone rather than captured by the loop.
The screening rows in this grid do not carry a trace field; trace identity comes from the config, not per cell.
